Elon Musk faces questions on Starlink's India operations and political spending

SpaceX CEO Elon Musk has faced scrutiny regarding Starlink's services in India, with a tech industry executive questioning the revenue model and affordability of the satellite internet service. Separately, Indian X users have highlighted Musk's political spending in the US in response to his comments about regulatory issues in India, with some users referring to him as 'President Musk' and a 'Trump lackey'. The issue of Starlink's operations in India has also been framed as a national security question.
